开发中 · 车载总线与诊断: In development · In-vehicle bus and diagnostics
车上的几十个控制器共用一根线说话。从\"每一拍线上有一位\"开始，亲手搭出听懂它: The dozens of controllers in a car talk over one shared line. Starting from “one bit on the line each tick”, build a probe that understands them, and grow it step by step into a tester that reads fault codes and reflashes software.
插上总线，上面在说什么？: Plugged into the bus: what is being said on it?
车上几十个控制器共用的一对线。这里讲的是 CAN 总线（ISO 11898-1）: The pair of wires the dozens of controllers in a car share. The one here is the CAN bus (ISO 11898-1): at any moment there is one bit on the line, every controller sees it, and any of them can speak.
真实的总线上是两根线之间的电压差；游戏从\"每一拍线上有一位\"讲起，不讲电压、: On a real bus the bit is a voltage difference between two wires; the game starts from “one bit on the line each tick”, without voltages, terminating resistors or bit timing.
总线上的 0。只要有一个控制器说显性，整根线就是显性：它压过隐性。: A 0 on the bus. If any one controller says dominant, the whole line is dominant: it wins over recessive.
总线上的 1。只有所有控制器都说隐性（或者都不说话）时，线才是隐性。没人说话的总: A 1 on the bus. The line is recessive only when every controller says recessive (or none says anything). A bus nobody is talking on stays recessive.
探针每一拍把板从头跑一遍。寄存卡是板上唯一能跨过一拍的东西：这一拍存进去的值，下: The probe runs the board afresh each tick. A register is the one thing on it that lasts from one tick to the next: what is kept in it this tick can be read on the next.
一帧的第一位，一位显性。只有在总线连着安静了至少 11 位之后，控制器才能开口，: The first bit of a frame, one dominant bit. A controller may only start talking once the bus has been quiet for at least 11 bits, so the first dominant bit after that quiet is a start of frame.
帧起始后面的 11 位，高位在前。它说的是这条消息是什么（车速、门开没开……），: The 11 bits after the start of frame, highest first. It says what the message is (the speed, whether a door is open…), not who sent it; each message is sent by one controller.
真实的 CAN 还有 29 位的扩展标识符，游戏只用 11 位的。: Real CAN also has 29-bit extended identifiers; the game uses the 11-bit ones only.
车上的控制器共用一根<wiki-ref to=\"bus\"></wiki-re: The controllers in a car share one <wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>. In this chapter you build a probe that only listens: plug it into the bus and work out what is being said on it.
探针每一拍跑一遍你的板。板左边的总线元件给出这一拍线上的那一位：0 是<wiki: The probe runs your board once a tick. The bus part on its left gives this tick’s bit on the line: 0 is <wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>, 1 is <wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>. Running is time: the waveform below moves on one tick a cell.
板每一拍从头跑一遍，只看得到这一拍。没人说话时线一直是隐性；一帧开始，线上才有了: The board runs afresh each tick and sees only that tick. With nobody talking the line stays recessive; once a frame starts, dominant bits appear.
每一拍，把总线上的那一位原样交出去。: Every tick, give out the bit on the bus as it is.
把左边的总线元件接到右边的输出上。: Wire the bus part on the left into the output on the right.
板每一拍从头跑，上一拍的东西它一样也记不住。可总线上的一位只有和前后连起来看才有: The board starts afresh each tick and remembers nothing of the last one. Yet a bit on the bus only means something next to the bits around it.
探针多了一种能力：<wiki-ref to=\"register\"></wik: The probe gains one ability: <wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>s. <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores the value wired into it this tick, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it back on the next one; two parts with the same name are the same register. The reading one has a start value: what it reads before anything is kept.
寄存卡把一拍和下一拍连了起来：从现在起，板能记事了。: A register ties one tick to the next: from now on the board can remember.
每一拍交出总线上一拍的那一位；第一拍交出 1。: Every tick, give out the bit the bus had the tick before; 1 on the first tick.
这一拍的总线存起来，下一拍读出来交出去。: Keep the bus this tick, and give out what you read next tick.
能记住上一拍以后，就能看出线什么时候变了。新元件<part-ref to=\"p: Remembering the last tick, the board can tell when the line changes. A new part, <part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>: yes when its two values are equal, no when they are not; it has a second form, Less than.
一张寄存卡加一个比较，板就看得出线在哪一拍变了。: A register and a comparison, and the board can see the tick the line changes.
每一拍回答：总线这一拍的位和上一拍一样吗？第一拍拿它和 1 比。: Every tick, answer: is the bit on the bus the same as the tick before? On the first tick, compare it with 1.
要知道一位落在一帧的哪里，得会数。寄存卡记得住一个数，还缺一样把它往上加的东西。: To know where a bit falls in a frame, the board has to count. A register can hold a number; what is missing is something to add to it.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:arith\"></part-re: A new part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: its form Add one gives its input plus 1, and Add gives the sum of its two inputs.
读出、加一、存回去：一个绕过寄存卡的小圈，每拍转一次，就是计数。: Read, add one, keep it: a small loop through a register, once round each tick, is a count.
每一拍交出这是第几拍：第一拍是 0。: Every tick, give out which tick this is: the first is 0.
探针刚插上时不知道总线正说到哪里，要先等一阵。等多久是一个定好的数，板上还没有能: A probe just plugged in does not know where the bus is in what it is saying, so it waits a while first. How long is a fixed number, and the board has no part yet that holds a number.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:const\"></part-re: A new part, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>: always gives the number it is set to.
计数加上一个比较，就是\"等到第几拍\"。: A count and a comparison make “wait until tick so-and-so”.
从第 11 拍（从 0 数起）开始一直回答「是」，在那之前回答「否」。: Answer yes from tick 11 on (counting from 0), and no before it.
数拍只会一直往上数。要数\"连着多少拍\"，得在断的那一拍把数清零：板要能在两个: Counting ticks only goes up. To count “how many in a row”, the count has to go back to zero on the tick the run breaks: the board has to pick one of two values.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:select\"></part-r: A new part, <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>: when its condition is yes or 1 it gives its Yes input, when it is no or 0 its No input; an input left open reads 「—」.
交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；「接着数」为 0 的那一拍过后从: Gives how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this tick; after a tick where Go on is 0 it counts from 0 again. Each counter has registers of its own.
这块板现在是一个元件了，板上放几块，就各数各的。: This board is now a part, and several of them on one board each keep their own count.
每一拍交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；它一是 0，就从 0 重数。: Every tick, give out how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this one; once it is 0, start again from 0.
没人说话时总线一直是隐性。一个控制器开口，先说一位显性：这一位叫<wiki-re: With nobody talking the bus stays recessive. A controller that starts talking first says one dominant bit: the <wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>.
可一帧里面到处都有显性。只有在总线确实安静过一阵以后的那个显性，才是一帧的开头。: Yet a frame is full of dominant bits. Only the dominant bit after the bus has really been quiet for a while is where a frame begins.
一帧的最后是 11 位隐性：应答界定位、7 位帧结束、3 位帧间间隔。所以两帧紧: A frame ends with 11 recessive bits: the ACK delimiter, 7 bits of end of frame and 3 of intermission. So even with frames back to back, this rule still finds the next one.
总线连着至少 11 拍隐性之后的第一个显性，回答「是」；其余每一拍回答「否」。: Answer yes on the first dominant bit after at least 11 recessive ones in a row, and no on every other tick.
数出这一拍之前隐性连着多长。: Count how long the recessive run before this tick is.
显性是 0，可以拿它和常数 0 比。: Dominant is 0, and can be compared with a constant 0.
总线上的数是一位一位到的：说话的控制器先说最高位。探针要把它们攒回一个数。: Numbers come over the bus a bit at a time, the highest bit first. The probe has to gather them back into a number.
攒下的数后面多接一位，它在二进制里整体左移了一格，再加上新来的那一位。: Putting one more bit after the number gathered so far shifts it one place left in binary, then adds the new bit.
「接着攒」为 1 时，把「位」接到攒下的数末尾，交出新的数；为 0 时交出 0: When Go on is 1, puts Bit at the end of the number gathered and gives the new number; when it is 0, gives 0 and empties. Each one has registers of its own.
一个数加上自己，就是左移一格；再加上新的一位，就接上了。: A number added to itself is shifted one place left; add the new bit and it is on the end.
「接着攒」为 1 的每一拍，把「位」接到已经攒下的数的末尾（先来的位在高位），交: On every tick Go on is 1, put Bit at the end of the number gathered so far (the first bit highest) and give out the number; on a tick it is 0, give out 0 and start over.
认得出一帧从哪开始，也会把位攒成数，探针就能读出第一样东西：这一帧是哪条消息。每: Knowing where a frame starts and how to gather bits into a number, the probe can read the first thing: which message this frame is. Every frame begins with an 11-bit <wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>, which says what the message is and how urgent.
一个帧起始只亮一拍，可之后的 11 拍都要知道\"我在一帧里面\"。: A start of frame lights for one tick, yet the 11 ticks after it all need to know “I am inside a frame”.
两块计数器各数各的：一块数总线安静了多久，一块数进帧以后过了几拍。: The two counters count on their own: one how long the bus was quiet, one how many ticks since the frame began.
帧起始后面的 11 位是这一帧的标识符。在它最后一位到达的那一拍交出标识符，其余: The 11 bits after the start of frame are the frame’s identifier. Give it out on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.
帧起始那一拍，在寄存卡里记下\"进帧了\"，之后一直记着。: On the start of frame, keep “in a frame” in a register, and keep it there.
进帧以后的拍数，用一块<part-ref to=\"counter\"></pa: Count the ticks since then with a <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>.
刚才读标识符时，试的是开头没有填充位的帧。换一条消息，连续相同的位之间会多出一位: The identifiers read so far had no stuff bits at the start. Other messages contain an extra bit: after five equal bits in a row, the sender inserts one opposite bit.
接收方要跳过填充位。注意，填充位本身也算线上连续位的第一位；后面若再有四位与它相: The receiver skips the stuff bit. The stuff bit itself starts the next run on the line; if four more bits match it, the following bit is stuffed too.
数的是线上连续的位，包括被跳过的填充位。: The run is counted on the line, including the stuff bit that was skipped.
记住上一拍的位和连着相同的位数。: Remember the previous bit and the length of its run.
上一拍刚数到五，这一拍就是填充位；仍要把它记作新的一段的第一位。: If the run reached five on the previous tick, this tick is stuffed; still count it as the first bit of the next run.
现在用搭好的元件试一段更容易出错的位串：填充位后面紧跟四个与它相同的位。: Try the part on a trickier stream: four bits equal to a stuff bit follow it.
两次填充可以只隔四个原始位，因为第一次的填充位也参与计数。: Two stuff bits can be separated by just four original bits, because the first stuff bit also counts.
去除位串中的填充位，并把剩下的位交出来；填充位的那一拍交出「—」。: Remove the stuff bits and give out the remaining bits; give 「—」 on each stuff-bit tick.
输入是一段从第一位开始、已经填充的位串。原始位到来时交出它并让「有效」为是；填充: The input is a stuffed stream from its first bit. Give each original bit and set Valid to yes; on a stuff bit give 「—」 and set Valid to no.
从一段从头开始的填充位串中跳过填充位；该拍交出「—」并让「有效」为否，其余拍交出: Skips stuff bits in a stuffed stream starting at its beginning: gives 「—」 and Valid no on a stuff bit, otherwise gives the bit and Valid yes. Each part has its own registers.
把去除填充位后的位依次攒成一个数，每拍交出当前的数。填充位那一拍保持原数；开始时: Gather the bits after removing stuff bits into a number, and give the current number each tick. Keep it unchanged on a stuff-bit tick; start at zero.
「有效」为否时保留寄存卡里的数；为是时将它左移一位并加上新位。: When Valid is no, keep the register’s number; when yes, shift it left and add the new bit.
现在可以从真实的帧里读下一样东西：数据长度。标准格式的数据帧从帧起始开始，接着是: Now read another field in a real frame: its data length. A standard-format data frame begins with start of frame, then an 11-bit identifier, RTR, IDE and a reserved bit, followed by four data-length bits.
这一关从帧起始的第一拍开始，只读一帧。数位置时只数原始位；填充位占了一拍，却不属: This level starts on the first tick of the frame and reads one frame. Count positions in original bits only; a stuff bit occupies a tick but belongs to no field.
读出这帧的四位数据长度，在最后一位原始长度位到达时交出它；其他拍交出「—」。第一: Read the four-bit data length and give it on the tick its last original bit arrives; give 「—」 on all other ticks. The first tick is start of frame, at position zero.
先用去除填充位元件；只有「有效」为是的拍才让位置加一。: Remove stuff bits first; advance the position only on ticks where Valid is yes.
长度字段的位置是 15 至 18。用寄存卡在这四位到达时攒数，最后一位到达时交出: The length occupies positions 15 to 18. Use a register to gather those four bits and give the result on the last bit.
位置是原始位的位置，时间则是线上经过的拍数；一旦有填充，这两个数就不同。: Position counts original bits, while time counts ticks on the line. Once stuffing occurs, the two differ.
